Command.Comment: ecaz Task 107 phase1 rabitq 100k l1 coordinator-only load

commands: PG_BIN=/usr/pgsql-18/bin; if [ ! -x "$PG_BIN/psql" ]; then PG_BIN=$(dirname "$(command -v psql)"); fi

upload_artifacts() { status=$1; echo step=upload-artifacts status=$status; for f in df-before.log df-after.log drop.log residue-before.log residue-after-drop.log load.log inspect.log; do if [ -f "$NODE_DIR/$f" ]; then aws s3 cp "$NODE_DIR/$f" "s3://$BUCKET/$S3_PREFIX/$f" --region us-west-2 || true; fi; done; }

"$PG_BIN/psql" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -U ecaz_coord -d postgres -At -c "SELECT relname FROM pg_class WHERE relname LIKE 'task107_phase1_rabitq_100k_l1%' ORDER BY relname;" > "$NODE_DIR/residue-before.log"
if [ -s "$CORPUS" ]; then echo corpus-present "$CORPUS"; else aws s3 cp "s3://$BUCKET/$CORPUS_KEY" "$CORPUS" --region us-west-2; fi
if [ -s "$QUERIES" ]; then echo queries-present "$QUERIES"; else aws s3 cp "s3://$BUCKET/$QUERIES_KEY" "$QUERIES" --region us-west-2; fi
if [ -s "$MANIFEST" ]; then echo manifest-present "$MANIFEST"; else aws s3 cp "s3://$BUCKET/$MANIFEST_KEY" "$MANIFEST" --region us-west-2; fi

"$PG_BIN/psql" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -U ecaz_coord -d postgres -c "DROP INDEX IF EXISTS task107_phase1_rabitq_100k_l1_idx; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS task107_phase1_rabitq_100k_l1_queries CASCADE; DROP TABLE IF EXISTS task107_phase1_rabitq_100k_l1_corpus CASCADE;" > "$NODE_DIR/drop.log" 2>&1

"$PG_BIN/psql" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h 127.0.0.1 -p 5432 -U ecaz_coord -d postgres -At -c "SELECT relname FROM pg_class WHERE relname LIKE 'task107_phase1_rabitq_100k_l1%' ORDER BY relname;" > "$NODE_DIR/residue-after-drop.log"

/usr/local/bin/ecaz corpus load --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5432 --user ecaz_coord --database postgres --prefix task107_phase1_rabitq_100k_l1 --corpus-file "$CORPUS" --queries-file "$QUERIES" --manifest-file "$MANIFEST" --allow-manifest-mismatch --profile ec_spire --dim 1536 --bits 4 --seed 42 --storage-format rabitq --index-name task107_phase1_rabitq_100k_l1_idx --reloption local_store_count=1 --log-file "$NODE_DIR/load.log"
